Utpala

Utpala

Utpala,_Bhaṭṭotpala
jy. a Kashmirian according to Alberuni. Finished two of his C.s. in 966 A. D.
--[Argalapraśna. Burnell 79b. This is his Āryāsaptati or Praśnakalikā. See TD. 11501. See above p. 178a].
--[Āryāsaptati or Praśnajñāna. See below Praśnajñāna].
--C. on Khaṇḍakhādya of Brahmagupta. Q. also by a. in his C. on Bṛhatsaṁhīta, 5. 19.
--Gūḍhamāna, Praśna. Mentioned by Alberuni, Sachau, p. 158. C.. Praśna works of his below.
--[Jñānamālā. B. IV. 138. BORI. 346 of 1879-80. P. 15. This is Praśnajñāna or Āryāsaptati].
--Praśnajñāna or Praśna, P. kalikā, P. saptati or Āryāsaptati.
Q. by a. in his own C. on Ṣaṭpañcāśikā, II. 2, III. 2, VII. 13 (asmadīye Praśnajñāne).
See above p. 178a, Āryāsaptati.
Pt.. with Eng. transl., Bangalore, 1949.
--Praśnapradīpa (?) Oudh XX. 108. C. on Pṛthuyaśas' work or his own Āryāsaptati ?
--C. Jagaccandrikā, on Bṛhajjātaka of Varāhamihira. Written in 966 A. D. [Page316-b]
Pt.. Pothī form, Bombay, 1864, 1874.
--C. Bṛhatsaṁhitā of Varāhamihira. Written in 966 A. D.
Ed. Viz. Skt. Ser. 10, 12; 1895, 1897.
--C. in verses on ib. (?)-Bṛ. j. ślokavyākhyāna-q. by Viśvanātha. Oxf. 338a.
--C. on Bṛhanmānasa. Mentioned by Alberuni, Sachau, p. 157.
--Bhaṭṭotpalīya. jy. Which work ? Oppert II. 6356.
--C. on Yogayātrā of Varāhamihira. L. 47.
--Ramala ? B. IV. 186.
--Rāhunrā (?) Karaṇa. Mentioned by Alberuni, Sachau, p. 157.
--C. Śiṣyahitā, on Laghujātaka of Varāhamihira.
--Vāstuvidyā. Q. by a. himself in his C. on Bṛhatsaṁhitā, 52. 57.
--C. on Vivāhakhaṇḍa or V. paṭala or Ṭikkaṇikīyātrā of Varāhamihira. Baroda 9316. Nepal II. p. 85 (ms. III. 391).
--C. Cintāmaṇi, on Ṣaṭpañcāśikā or Horāṣaṭpañcāśikā of Pṛthuyaśas.
The Bādarāyaṇapraśnaṭīkā, Cintāmaṇi, of Utpala, L. 1522 an. Rgb. 829. seems to be the same, but with some changes an. introduction of the name Bādarāyaṇa in place of Pṛthuyaśas.
Pt.. Pothī form, Bombay 1864.
--Sārāvalīpūraṇa. Completion of Kalyāṇavarman's work. Bomb. Uni. 476.
--Sūryasiddhāntaṭīkā. Q. by Divākara in Prauḍhamanoramā.
--Srūdhava (?) Mentioned by Alberuni, Sachau, p.. 334, 361. [Page317-a.
--[Yuddhajayārṇava, tantric, ms. RASB. VIII. A. 6109, mentions Bhaṭṭa Utpala a. a. by mistake.]
Q.s in IO. I. p. 1082a an. II. p. 445a are Utpala's q.s from Samudra on Sāmudrika. These may be from one of his C.s., most probably on Bṛhatsaṁhitā.

Utpalagaurīvratakalpa
vrata. MD. 8218 (inc.).

Utpaladeva,_Utpala
of Kashmir; son of Udayākara, disciple of Somānanda, guru of Lakṣmaṇagupta an. grand-preceptor of Abhinavagupta; end of the 9th an. first half of the 10th cent.; teacher also of Rāmakaṇṭha (a. of Vyomavyāpistava), Adyar; mentioned a. preceptor by Maheśvaratejānandanātha in his Ānandakalpalatikā, MT. 1698.
--Ajaḍapramātṛsiddhi. See NCC. I. p. 63.
Part of his Siddhitrayī, ptd. in Kas. Texts 34, 1921.
--Īśvarapratyabhijñākārikā(-sūtra). See above, p. 275b. 276a.
--C. on above, Madhyapratyabhijñā or Ṭīkā. See above, p. 276a.
--C. on above, Laghupratyabhijñā or Vṛtti. See above, p. 276a.
--Īśvarasiddhi with Vṛtti. See above p. 278. Part of his Siddhitrayī.
--Parameśvarastotrāvalī. Report XXX. same a. Stotrāvalī below ?
--Śivadṛṣṭivṛtti.
Written for his son Vibhramākara an. a classmate Padmānanda.
Ed.. Kas. Texts 56. 1934.
--Sambandhasiddhi with Vṛtti. Part of his Siddhitrayī.
--Stotrāvalī or Śivastotrāvalī.
Pt.. Chowkhambā, Banaras 1902-3. [Page317-b]
--[Bhāvopahārastotra of Utpala cited in Ratnakaṇṭha's C. on Jagaddhara's Stutikusumāñjali 19. 16 (K. M. 23) is only stotra 13 (called Saṅgraha, not Bhāvopahāra), verse 17 in the Stotrāvalī above.].
--verses on Śiva composed by him are in a codex along with Śārikānityapūjāpaddhati (RASB. VIII. A. 6400). The verse extracted here is not in the collection Śivastotrāvalī noted above.
--Q. on music in the Abhinavabhāratī. C.. JOR. Madras VI. 164.

Utpaladeva
--Mantrasāra. BORI. 501 of 1895-98. Peters. VI. 501.

Utpalaparimala
name of a C. on Bṛhatsaṁhitā of Varāhamihira, by Yogin or Yogīśvara, son of Kumāra of Vārṣagaṇya kula an. pupil of Nirupamabodha an. who wrote when the Hoysala King Narasiṁha was in Śrīraṅgam. In one set of mss. (MD. 13586 an. IO. 6327), a. add. verse is found mentioning the a. a. Bhāskara of Naidhruvakāśyapakula. Completed in A. D. 1235. MD. 13585-6.
See also J. of the Sri Venk. Ori. Inst., Tirupati, II. i. p.. 49-55.

Utpalaparimala
by Pṛthuyaśas (?) Rice 324.

jy. by Govinda Bhaṭṭa (?) Rice 28.

Utpalamata
Kavīndrācārya 2190.

Utpalamālā
lex.
--C. Dīpikā by Govindapāda.
Q. in Amarakhaṇḍana of Śrīharṣa. Mentioned in the Dṛṣṭāntasiddhāñjana a C. by Kallolabhaṭṭācārya on his grandfather Sujana's lex., Śabdaliṅgārthacandrikā. See JOR. Madras. V. p.. 11, 12, 23, 25; Amaramaṇḍana edn., Deccan College, Poona, 1949, Intro., [Page318-a. p.. 8, 9, an. Adyar Library Bulletin VII. p. 41. Mss. notes.

Utpalamālikā

Utpalamālinī
lex. by Śubhāṅka(-ṅga). See Intro. p. xxvi, Kalpadrukośa, GOS. XLII. Vol. I.
Q. by Sarvānanda on Amarakośa II. 6. 6, by Nārāyaṇa Vidyāvinoda on same (JOR., Madras XII. 9, 16) an. Jaumāranandin's C. on Saṁkṣiptasāra.

Utpalarāja
name of the Paramāra King Muñja alias Vākpatirāja of Mālwa, uncle an. predecessor of Bhoja. Verses of his q. in Anthologies, an. Alaṁkāra works, e.g. Au. v.. carcā 16; Daśarūpakāvaloka IV. 58, 60; Kavikaṇṭhābharaṇa II. 1; Suvṛttatilaka II. 6; Skm. p.. 64, 162, 316; (other verses under the name Muñja); Śp. 1017.

Utpala_Vaiṣṇava
of Kashmir, son of Trivikrama of Nārāyaṇasthāna; refers to an. quotes from the maternal grandfather of his father, Mahābala; called ‘Vaiṣṇava’ to distinguish him from the Kashmirian Śaiva teacher Utpaladeva.
--Bhogamokṣapradīpikā. Q. in the next, (twice) (p.. 14b. 22a-b, BORI. ms. 512 of 1875-76; p. 49, Viz. Skt. Ser. edn.).
--Spandapradīpikā. Ms. BORI. 512 of 1875-76. 173 of 1883-84.
Ed.. Viz. Skt. Ser. 14, Banares 1898.
Without mentioning the name, he q. some other text of his too on p.. 17b-18a, 24b (mayaiva coktaM kvApi).

Utpalaśānti
to ward off the evil of the growth of mushrooms in a house-compound. MD. 14469. [Page318-b]
--from Daivajñavallabha. MD. 14470.

Utpalinī
lex.
by Vyāḍi acc. to Hārāvalī, Kāvyakalpalatāvṛtti etc. See p.. xi-xii, Intro., Kalpadrukośa, GOS. XLII, Vol. I. Widely q. in C.s on Amarakośa an. Kāvyas, an. used in other lex.s.
E.g. see the following C.s on Amarakośa: by Rāyamakuṭa (Adyar D. VI. 966. BP. p. 61; see also ZDMG. 28 (1874) 111); by Rāmanātha Vidyāvācaspati (Adyar D. VI. 944); by Nārāyaṇa Vidyāvinoda (See JOR. Madras, XII. 9); by Bhānuji (Oxf. 182b); mentioned in the following lex.s.,--in Puruṣottama's Hārāvali (Adyar D. VI. 1025); in Trikāṇḍaviveka (IO. 963); in Trikāṇḍaśeṣa (IO. 993); in Medinī; in Śivadatta's C. on his Śivakośa (Gode, Stud. in Ind. Lit. His.. I. 45); in the Nānākośasaṅgraha (MT. 1071); q. by Ujjvaladatta in his Vṛtti on Uṇādisūtras, p. 141, Calcutta edn.; in C.s on Kāvya-by Mallinātha (Oxf. 113a, 126a); Śivarāma, Śarvacandra etc. on Vāsavadattā (Gode, Stud. in Ind. Lit. His.. I. p.. 268, 270-3 an. IO. 4077) an. so on.

Utprekṣāvallabha
poet. real name Gokula a. stated in his Sundarīśataka; from his Bhikṣāṭanakāvya, he appears to have been known also a. Śivabhaktadāsa.
--Bhikṣāṭanakāvya.
Pt.. K. M. Gucch. 12. Several verses from here in Smv.
--Sundarīśataka, written a. the instance of King Madana.
Pt.. K. M. Gucch. 9.

Utprekṣitavallabha
name of the a. Mādhava, son of Maṇḍala Bhaṭṭa, younger brother of ‘Paṇḍitarāja’ an. patronised by Kṛṣṇadāsa of Mihiravaṁśa.
--Saptaśatī (in the style of Govardhana's Āryāsaptaśatī). Ms., Bikaner. See here verse 35, Intro. Composed in A. D. 1608. Mentions Govinda Bhaṭṭa alias Akbarīyakālidāsa. J. of the Tanjore Sar. Mah. Lib. VI. 1. p.. 7-10.
